panduan_lengkap: Welcome to the Ultimate Sound Theme Maker Comprehensive User Guide.
This guide is designed line by line so you can read it with left or right swipes using a screen reader without interruption.
Below is the complete journey and the deepest technical explanations for every button, menu, and long press action from the main page to the core system.
--- MAIN MENU ---
In the Main Menu page, there are 17 main feature buttons. Here is the flow and function:

1. 'Change Language' Button: When you click this button, a dialog will appear showing a list of language files available in the system (e.g. 'indonesia' and 'inggris'). Once you select a language, the system will automatically save your preference and instantly reload the application interface in the newly selected language without the need to restart Jieshuo.

2. 'Settings' Button: If clicked, the system will load and open a long list dialog containing all the core configurations of this application. In it, you can adjust everything from volume, automatic talking clock, audio compression quality, to overhauling event names. A super detailed explanation of the steps inside this menu is in the 'SETTINGS MENU DETAILS' chapter below.

3. 'Edit current sound theme' Button: A lightning-fast shortcut that will take you straight diving into the event list of the theme you are currently using. This saves a lot of time because you no longer need the hassle of searching for the theme name in the long list. (Note: If you are using a Demo Theme or Default Theme, the system will block access to prevent configuration data damage).

4. 'Edit Sound Theme' Button: Clicking this button will take you to the theme management center. The system will scan your storage folder and display a list of all the themes you own. On this page, you will find a quick search box, a selection mode button for mass actions, and a list of themes that trigger advanced features when touched or long-pressed. Detailed explanations are in the 'EDIT SOUND THEME MENU DETAILS' chapter.

5. 'Create Talking Clock' Button: When you press this menu, the system will first smartly check if you have a pending manual recording draft. If there is, 3 handling options will appear: 'Continue', 'Start New' (the system will safely delete the draft in the background first), and 'Later'. If you start a new session, you don't record immediately, but will be guided through 4 dialog steps in succession. First, the 'Select Clock Type' dialog (Auto TTS Clock or Record Yourself). Second, the 'Select Clock Component' dialog (only process Hour and Minute, or complete with Exact Hour recordings). Third, the 'Select Format' dialog (12 Hour Format or 24 Hour Format). Fourth, the 'Select Target Sound Theme' dialog as its storage container. Only after this 4-step route is confirmed will the engine execute it. If you choose the 'Auto TTS Clock' method, the system will assemble dozens of clock voice files from scratch using your chosen robot TTS engine, and automatically compress them to M4A or OGG if the Automatic Conversion switch is active. However, if you choose the 'Record Yourself (Manual)' method, the TTS engine will whisper instructions into your ear (e.g., 'Okay, time to say: five past'). The system then counts down 1, 2, 3. After the third count, your entire Android screen will be frozen into an invisible touch canvas. Swipe the screen DOWN to start recording. While recording, swipe the screen UP to stop. If you want to close or cancel the session, swipe the screen LEFT or RIGHT. This gesture system is very specially designed so as not to trigger a click-back sound from Jieshuo, ensuring your recording is 100% crystal clear. After you stop swiping, you can play the preview and save your progress one by one.

6. 'Create Effect' Button: When you click this menu, the system will read the storage folder and bring up a list of your sound themes. If you choose one theme as the target, an advanced Multi-File Picker will open. Here, you are free to select one or dozens of audio files at once from your phone storage. After you click 'Process Effect', the system will not just copy them blindly. Instead, the system will bring up a dialog box one by one to give you a chance to rename the files neatly. If the file name you entered turns out to already exist in the 'effect' subfolder on the target theme, the anti-crash security system will appear instantly, asking if you want to 'Overwrite', 'Rename' automatically, or 'Skip' the file. After all is confirmed, then the engine copies all the audio safely in the background.

7. 'Delete Theme Components (Clock/Effect)' Button: If you feel your storage is getting full or want to remove clock and effect features from several themes, this button is a quick solution. When clicked, the system will ask which component you want to destroy: 'Clock Folder' or 'Effect Folder'. After that, you are asked to determine the theme source, whether from 'Jieshuo Themes (Internal)' or from an 'External Folder'. The script will then scan and display a list of themes that have that component, complete with a mass Selection Mode feature. You can check dozens of themes at once. Once you press 'Delete Selected', the system will execute the deletion of these components safely from all checked themes in an instant, without damaging the main audio files of the themes themselves.

8. 'Create Demo Sound Theme' Button: If clicked, the system will collect data and display a special interface containing a list of all Jieshuo events. Initially, all will have the status 'Not set'. Clicking on an event row will open a file picker, allowing you to assign audio to that event. The radar system will immediately read the screen text and play the audio you just entered as a preview. At the top of this screen, there is a 'Use Demo Sound Theme' button that will directly test your half-finished concoction into the Jieshuo engine, a 'Make Original Sound Theme' button to wrap this demo into a permanent theme by asking you to enter a new theme name which is validated for security, and a 'Delete Demo' button to sweep clean all the drafts of the demo concoction right down to its roots.

9. 'Create Instant Demo' Button: This is the very fast reverse of the regular Demo feature. If clicked, the system instantly bypasses the event list and opens the audio file picker. After you select one audio file from storage, a long list containing all Jieshuo event names (like Click, Swipe, etc.) will appear. Clicking one event will map the audio instantly. If the event you clicked turns out to already contain audio from a previous session, the safety system will prevent forced overwriting and pop up a confirmation dialog. After the audio is successfully mapped, an options menu will pamper you: You can choose to 'Continue Editing Theme' (return to the file picker in a flash), apply directly to the system with 'Use Theme', save it as an original theme, delete it, or directly exit to the main menu.

10. 'Import SPK File' Button: When clicked, the file picker will open and smartly filter your memory to only show files ending with the .spk extension. You are allowed to check multiple SPK files at once. If you click 'Import', all those files will be extracted in a queue safely into your theme folder. Amazingly, if you click 'Import & Apply', all files will be extracted, and then the system will detect: If only 1 file was imported, it is immediately activated automatically. However, if there is more than 1 SPK file imported at once, the system will bring up a smart dialog asking: 'Out of the themes just imported, which one do you want to apply directly?'. Your choice will be immediately injected as the main sound theme in Jieshuo settings.

11. 'External Theme Manager' Button: An advanced feature to manage sound themes located outside the default Jieshuo folder (e.g., in the Download or Documents folder). If clicked, the system will open a special file explorer. You can browse internal memory and if you find a sound theme folder, you just tap it once to directly import it into the Jieshuo system. If you long-press the theme folder, you can directly export it into an SPK file to share, backup it as an SPK into the central vault folder (/nadi cadangan SPK), rename it, or delete it. This feature is also equipped with a mass Selection Mode to export or delete multiple themes at once safely from outside the reach of Jieshuo's radar.

12. 'Theme Sound Code List' Button: If clicked, the system will display a complete list of event names (like Touch, Scroll, etc.) along with their original Lua code injection written below the name (e.g., service.play("click")). A short tap on the row will directly copy the code to your clipboard with a sound notification. A long press on the row will send an execution command to the engine in the background to render the code, so you can hear the sound preview of that event right in your ear without having to apply it to the screen.

13. 'Backup Menu' Button: Clicking this button will bring up 3 layers of iron-clad menus for your data security: 'Backup Sound Theme Data' to quickly copy theme folders to the /.cadangan partition system, 'Restore Sound Theme Data' to bring back corrupted or lost folders, and 'Check Data Integrity' to automatically scan for damage or unauthorized modifications. The workflow of each button is fully discussed in the 'BACKUP MENU DETAILS' chapter below.

14. 'Sound Theme Community' Button: The center for sharing creations! If clicked, you will face two doors: 'Upload' and 'Download'. The Upload feature is restricted to Premium users and Admins only. When uploading, the system will forcefully compress your theme into an SPK extension by stamping the timestamp and username, queuing it, and using a temporary server token from RAM. The Download feature is open to all. The system uses the Git Trees API to break through file limits. You can display public themes by All (A-Z) or by Username. Downloaded SPKs will be permanently saved in 'Download/Tema Suara' and automatically cleaned from timestamp numbers. Exclusively for Main Admins, a long press on the theme list will send a direct deletion command to the GitHub server.

15. 'User Guide' Button: If clicked, the system will call and render the text from this currently active language file into a line-by-line dialog interface, allowing you to read these deep instructions comfortably using a screen reader.

16. 'Upgrade to Premium' Button: Displays your current account status (Free, Premium, or Admin) and details all the exclusive features you can enjoy if you switch to the Premium version. In this menu, you can also trigger the automatic system to place a package order instantly via WhatsApp.

17. 'About' Button: Brings up a pop-up information dialog containing a special birthday dedication message, copyright details, and an action button to 'Join Telegram'. If the Telegram button is clicked, the script will neatly close all windows and call the Android system default (Intent) to directly direct you to the Telegram application, opening the community group link instantly.
--- SETTINGS MENU DETAILS ---
If you open the 'Settings' menu, you are presented with a full control panel with a dynamic interface (advanced sub-menus only appear if the main switch is active). Here is the configuration journey:
Row 'Enable or disable sound themes': When clicked, the system inverts the internal Jieshuo boolean value instantly.

Row 'Theme Volume and Sound Settings': Appears if the sound theme is active. Contains a dialog to adjust volume percentage precisely (forcing the engine to restart its audio bridge so changes are instant) and a button to change the currently airing sound theme.
Row 'Enable or disable vibration': Turns Jieshuo's haptic feedback on or off.

Row 'Current vibration intensity': Appears if vibration is active. Clicking this menu brings up options ranging from 'Smallest' to 'Largest'. Your choice will immediately inject reCreate() into the system so the new vibration is immediately felt on the next swipe.
Row 'Enable or disable talking clock': Controls the Jieshuo reminder time switch.

Row 'Talking Clock Settings': Appears if the talking clock is active. This is your time control center. Inside is the 'Talking Clock Interval' (5 to 60 minutes) and 'Sound at' (checking active hours 00:00 to 23:00 to isolate sleep time). In this menu, you are also free to configure a specific TTS Engine for the clock, adjust Text-to-speech rate, Speech speed, Volume, and Pitch without altering your main screen reader settings.

Row 'Automatic Audio Conversion' and 'Audio Conversion Settings': A switch to allow the engine to run conversion to M4A/OGG formats after recording. If active, the sub-menu allows you to lock the target Format, Sample Rate, and Bitrate.

Row 'Automatic Recording Quality' and 'Recording Quality Settings': Recording shortcuts. If enabled, the sub-menu lets you lock the microphone hardware profile (e.g., Anti-Noise Microphone or Raw), Sample Rate, and Mono/Stereo channel format. Every subsequent manual recording session will directly bypass the question panel for speed.

Row 'Talking Clock Creation Settings': Directs you to 4 clock component assembly menus. Ranging from robot TTS voice settings for auto clock, to a series of script assembly input boxes (with [ANGKA] variables) for 24-hour text, details of phrase separation for early morning, morning, afternoon, and past minutes.

Row 'Folder Settings', 'Event Name Settings', and 'Add New Sound Event': Functions to overhaul the parent folder name, change the event UI display name, or insert new events with the ability to precisely adjust their position (Bottom, Left, Right) in the memory table.

Extra Rows: 'Use Jieshuo Clipboard' diverts the copy stream to the internal log, while 'Use Jieshuo Numbers on Export' inserts a 14-digit automatic time naming when sharing SPKs, matching the style of files made by genuine Jieshuo.

Last Row: 'Reset Script Settings (Factory Default)'. Returns all custom script settings (like clock format, recording quality, event names) safely to factory defaults without deleting audio files or disturbing core Jieshuo settings (like volume or fingerprint DRM).
--- EDIT SOUND THEME MENU DETAILS ---

When you open the 'Edit Sound Theme' menu, you will see a control room consisting of a dynamic search box, a 'Favorite Themes List' button, a 'Create' new theme folder button, a mass selection mode, and a list of all your themes. Here is the magic of each action:

Button 'Favorite Themes List': If clicked, it will filter and only show themes that you have starred (favorited). You can directly click them to use them instantly, or long press to bring up all management menus normally.
Single Tap (Short Click) action on the theme list: The system will instantly navigate you into that theme folder, render the event list, and load the currently active audio paths.
Long Press (Long Click) action on the theme list: Will freeze the UI and pop up advanced options as follows:

1. 'Rename': Brings up an input box. After you type the new name, the script will safely engineer the folder name in external memory, and update its path if this theme is in the Favorites or Pinned list.

2. 'Delete': Will bring up a critical warning. If you confirm it, the script will call a recursive deletion function that silently wipes the entire theme folder off the face of the memory, along with its backup folder (if any).

3. 'Pin' or 'Unpin': Sends a command to the database to pin this theme. Pinned themes are automatically decorated with a [Pinned] label at the end of their name, and the sorting algorithm will always force them to float at number one in your theme list, beating the alphabet.
4. 'Add to Favorites' or 'Remove from Favorites': Will fire this theme name data into an exclusive JSON array, so the theme is instantly available when you open the Favorite Themes List panel.

5. 'Backup', 'Re-Backup', or 'Delete from Backup': This menu row is a manifestation of artificial intelligence. The system scans the status in the background; If the theme has never been backed up, it will offer 'Backup'. If the theme is detected to have been backed up but its contents have changed even by 1 byte, it will offer 'Re-Backup' and 'Delete from Backup'. If the file is 100% purely identical to the backup, it only offers 'Delete from Backup'.

6. 'Share': Triggers the Zip compiler. The system will compress the entire contents of the theme folder along with config.json into a .spk format file in seconds. After compression is complete, the script calls the Android Intent to throw the file to the Share menu, ready for you to send via WhatsApp, Telegram, or Drive.

7. 'Backup as SPK': Compresses the entire contents of the theme folder into an .spk file and saves it locally into the central vault in the '/nadi cadangan SPK' folder. The system will smartly embed a sequence number or time timestamp to prevent overwriting old backup files.

8. 'Remove Audio Format': An automatic sweep-clean feature. The system will dissect the contents of the JSON configuration file, detect all assigned audio files, and use string operations (Regex) to shave off text extensions like .mp3 or .ogg from their physical file names. Everything is tidied back up in the background.

9. 'Event Name Without Format': Forces the entire arrangement of audio file names inside that theme folder to be renamed to perfectly match its event UI name, without including any extension (example: if the original name was 'loud_sound.ogg' and assigned to the Click event, the physical file will be absolutely renamed to 'Click').

10. 'Event Name With Format': The logic is exactly the same as point 8, but the system will maintain its data type linkage by embedding the original extension back at the end of the name (example: name changes from 'loud_sound.ogg' to 'Click.ogg').

11. 'Delete Unregistered Audio': This is the Garbage Collector feature. The system will cross-check all physical files with audio extensions in the folder with the active mapping in config.json. If there is even one audio file in the folder that turns out to be idle (not mapped to any event), the file will be collected. After you click confirm, the system will execute deletion on those rogue files so your memory capacity becomes spacious again.

Button 'Enable Selection Mode': If pressed, the UI will transform. The search box disappears, and checkboxes appear attached to every theme. This mode allows you to select dozens of themes at once. 2 new execution buttons will appear:
Button 'Delete (X)': Triggers a mass deletion array. The script will bulldoze the X themes you checked simultaneously in one loading bar.

Button 'More Actions... (X)': Opens a pandora's box of mass menus. Here you can favorite, backup raw data, export SPKs to WhatsApp, or mass backup as SPKs to the local vault folder simultaneously safely and without damaging file structures.
--- DETAILS INSIDE A THEME (EVENT LIST) ---
When you successfully enter the hull of a theme (for example the 'Dark' theme), you are faced with an event list panel.

Button 'Import Audio': If clicked, opens a Multi-Picker dialog. You are free to browse and check, for example, 5 audio files at once from Download. If you choose 'Import', all 5 audios are sucked into the theme folder. If you choose 'Import & Apply', all five audios are sucked in, and the system immediately pops up a sequential dialog, asking you to determine the fate of each audio, assigning them to specific events one by one endlessly.
Single Tap Action on an Event (e.g.: Click 'Touch'): Will take you to a list of audio bullets stored inside the theme folder (with the added mandate of 'Default' and 'None').
Inside this audio bullet screen is the flow:

Single Tap on the audio row: Sends a confirmation signal that the audio officially serves in this event. The system directly writes the new configuration to JSON, triggers the MediaPlayer library in the background to echo the preview sound for a few milliseconds, then throws you smoothly back to the event list.
Long Press (Long Click) on the audio row: Pierces the file manager, where you can directly choose to 'Rename' the file, or 'Delete' to annihilate it from your memory.

Button 'Selection Mode' inside the audio bullet list: Flips the interface into a mass checklist table. Allows you to check dozens of leftover audio files to herd to the 'Delete' button, an ultimate method to clean up the theme folder extra fast.
--- BACKUP MENU DETAILS ---
From the very front interface page, if you enter the 'Backup Menu', you are guarded by 3 data system security forts:

1. 'Backup Sound Theme Data': If clicked, the system will parse the memory and bring up a table containing all unbacked-up themes, complete with checkboxes. You check your precious themes, click 'Backup', and the system will copy and clone the entire theme folder intact to the hidden system partition (/.cadangan), protecting it from accidental deletion.

2. 'Restore Sound Theme Data': The reverse of the backup process. If clicked, the system opens the /.cadangan vault and lists the themes. When you check a corrupted theme and click 'Restore', the system will crack open the vault, pull out the pure original data, and boldly overwrite your active theme folder out there. As a result, any corrupted files, shattered JSONs, or missing audios will instantly heal back to their original form.

3. 'Check Data Integrity': If clicked, you activate a deep detective algorithm. The script will dive into your memory, place the active theme and the backup theme side by side, and compare them atomically. The app counts the number of audio files, matches every file name, and unpacks the config.json code structure. If the script detects any mischievous interference (like files silently deleted or letters intentionally tampered within JSON), it will trigger a red alarm and pop up a list of warnings. You simply give a single tap on that warning row, and the system instantly sucks the healthiest version from the backup vault folder, re-copies it, and restores the integrity of your theme mercilessly and automatically.
--- SECURITY & UPDATE SYSTEM ---
This application has a high-level security system and Over-The-Air (OTA) updates. If you try to modify the script illegally, the system will detect it and your access will be permanently blocked.
If your screen is locked by an 'Access Blocked' warning, click the 'Ask for Forgiveness' button to enter your name. The system will copy a special registration code for you to send to the Admin.

After the Admin processes your forgiveness ticket, simply click the 'Check Status' button on that locked screen. The system will verify with the server, and if approved, the padlock will open instantly.
